description: CICCHINI / State Senate / ENOUGH (Official political campaign T-shirt of Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate District 9) The logo that launched a historic campaign for State Senate in Michigan. Independents embrace ALL colors on the spectrum, and this shirt reflects the commitment to include and represent everyone. Clean typography and a minimalist design make the message unmistakable and wearable anywhere: on the trail, at events, or in everyday life. Printed on a soft, lightweight unisex tee made from Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, it’s comfortable enough for long campaign days and durable enough to keep the message sharp over time. Product Features • 100% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton (lightweight, breathable) • Retail crew neck with ribbed knit collar and seam for shape retention • Side seams and shoulder tape for improved fit and long-term structure • Tear-away label; REACH certified; adult sizing; ethically produced • Durable DTF/DTG print for sharp, legible campaign graphics Care Instructions • Machine wash cold (max 30°C / 90°F) • Non-chlorine bleach as needed • Tumble dry low heat • Iron, steam, or dry at medium heat • Do not dry clean Paid for by Philippe Cicchini for Michigan State Senate, P.O. Box 244, Troy, MI 48099. Proceeds benefit the campaign committee.
